title: The Date Night Plant Board
seo_title: Vegan Date Night Board for Two: Shopping List & Plan
description: A vegan date night board for 2–4: aged cashew brie, truffle cashew cream, champagne grapes, pear, pomegranate, macadamias, dark chocolate and rosemary flatbread.
hook: A small, special board for two: aged cashew brie, a truffle cream, tiny champagne grapes and dark chocolate, made to go with a bottle of bubbles.

items.name: Agave with a drop of truffle oil

why: A board for two should be small and a little luxurious. Rich, buttery macadamias and a creamy aged cashew brie feel indulgent, and a truffle cashew cream adds the earthy, special-occasion note.

Champagne grapes, pear and pomegranate bring crisp sweetness that matches sparkling wine, and dark chocolate with a pinch of salt is the ending. Edible flowers make it look like you tried much harder than you did.

timeline.what: Take the cashew brie and truffle cream out of the fridge; chill the bubbles.
Place the cheeses; spoon the truffle agave into a tiny bowl.
Slice the pear; snip the champagne grapes into small clusters.
Add crackers, flatbread, macadamias and chocolate.
Scatter pomegranate, flowers and rose petals; pour the wine.

faq.a: Yes, every item is plant-based. Check the labels on crackers, breads and store-bought dips, which sometimes contain butter, milk, honey or egg.

faq.q: What can I use instead of champagne grapes?
faq.a: Small seedless red grapes cut into tiny clusters, or fresh figs when they're in season.

faq.q: How many people does it serve?
faq.a: 2 to 4 people as an appetizer, on a 12–14 inch board.
